description.narrative: Growth Gateway provides i) a free to access online digital service which provides information on accessing the UK market to potential UK trade or investment partners, ii) a Business Advisory Service which identifies high potential businesses which may be seeking to export, or to attract investments, and provides them with tailored advice, and iii) a portfolio of in-country interventions where analysis and technical assistance are provided by a specialist team to promote trade or investment opportunities in a given country.
